housing.summary: Numbeo lists a one-bedroom apartment in Geelong city centre at AUD 1,850 per month: https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Geelong. In Victoria, the usual maximum bond is one month's rent unless weekly rent exceeds AUD 900 or VCAT sets a higher amount: https://www.consumer.vic.gov.au/housing/renting/rent-bond-bills-and-condition-reports/bond/bond-amounts-and-paying-a-bond. The main national rental portal's Geelong search is https://www.realestate.com.au/rent/in-geelong,+vic+3220/list-1.

banking.summary: CommBank's official newcomer page says applicants show a current original passport in branch, bring each foreign-residency TIN, and provide an Australian residential address for full access.
required_docs: Current original passport for in-branch identity verification
Tax Identification Number (TIN) for each country of foreign tax residency
Australian residential address for full account access

schools.summary: Kardinia International College in Geelong is an IB World School offering the Primary Years Programme and Diploma Programme: https://www.kardinia.vic.edu.au/about. IB Schools Australasia provides the regional school directory: https://ibaustralasia.org/schools/.

legal_admin.summary: Most arriving passengers must complete and present an Incoming Passenger Card to Australian Border Force, including their intended Australian address and local contact details.
legal_admin.registration_step: Complete and present an Incoming Passenger Card when entering Australia (unless exempt), including the intended Australian address and contact details.

tax_finance.summary: A foreign-passport holder who is in Australia with a valid work-rights visa can apply free online for a Tax File Number through the ATO Individual Auto-Registration system.

transport.summary: Transport Victoria coordinates the public network; Geelong local buses use myki. McHarry's lists the 2026 one-zone full-fare monthly myki pass at AUD 118.60: https://mcharrys.com.au/travel-information/fare-information/. A person living in Victoria for more than six months must convert a valid overseas licence; recognized jurisdictions may avoid tests, while others require them: https://www.vicroads.vic.gov.au/licences/convert-your-licence/convert-overseas-licence. Eligible permanent residents can enrol in Medicare through myGov or with form MS004 and supporting identity/residency documents: https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/enrolling-medicare-if-youre-australian-permanent-resident?context=60092.
transport.network_name: Public Transport Victoria (PTV); myki ticketing on Geelong local buses
transport.driving_licence_exchange: If living in Victoria for more than 6 months, convert the overseas licence to a Victorian licence. Licences from recognized countries and jurisdictions generally do not require tests; other licence holders must pass the required tests.
transport.healthcare_registration: If eligible, enrol in Medicare online through myGov or submit Medicare enrolment form MS004 with required identity and residency evidence.
